svg.title: Publish-Subscribe
svg.desc: Publish-Subscribe. Broadcast each message to every interested subscriber through a topic. Step 1, Publish once, fan out: Orders publishes OrderPlaced once and is done; the broker puts a copy into every subscription. Step 2, Independent and durable: Analytics is offline: its copies wait and it catches up. The live dashboard just misses them. Step 3, Filter in the broker: Shipping's subscription filters on region = 'EU': it gets two of three; Billing gets all three. Step 4, Add a subscriber: Fraud adds its own subscription. Orders is not changed; Fraud gets what is published from now on.
